backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods or state; backend is unused as all data is static frontend content.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including hero text color changes, reservation form creation with WhatsApp integration, and form validation with required fields.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components describing their purpose, styling (gold/charcoal theme), and functionality including hero, menu, reservation, reviews, and WhatsApp integration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color system; defines design tokens for colors, borders, and shadows.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, LocalBusiness structured data for Perfetto Pizza Plus restaurant, and Google Fonts imports for Cormorant Garamond and Inter.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that composes all page sections (Hero, BusinessDetails, MenuSection, ReservationSection, ExtraCharges, ReviewsSection, Footer) and FloatingWhatsAppButton in order.
Displays restaurant rating (4.5 stars, 36 reviews), price range (₹200-400), and four service options (dine-in, takeaway, delivery, no-contact delivery) with gold-themed icons and elegant card styling.
frontend/src/components/ExtraCharges.tsx: Renders a table of pizza add-on charges (cheese burst, thin crust, extra cheese, extra toppings) with pricing for small/medium/large sizes using gold borders and elegant styling.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed-position floating button at bottom-right with WhatsApp green branding that opens chat with +919797957878 when clicked; includes hover animations and responsive text.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying restaurant contact info (address, phone), copyright notice, and attribution link to caffeine.ai with gold accent colors on charcoal background.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component displaying restaurant branding with logo, name, tagline, and three contact info cards (location, phone, hours) over a background image with overlay.
frontend/src/components/MenuCategory.tsx: Reusable menu category component that renders items either as a table with size-based pricing (small/medium/large) or as a grid with single prices.
frontend/src/components/MenuSection.tsx: Menu section component containing all pizza categories (Basic, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Super, Special) and other food categories (Burgers, Wraps, Sandwiches, Bread, Pasta, Momos) with their items and prices.
frontend/src/components/ReservationSecti: Table reservation form component with validation that collects guest details (name, mobile, email, guests, date, time, occasion, special requests) and sends the reservation request via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Customer reviews section displaying positive highlights and constructive feedback with star ratings, plus owner responses to address concerns.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity login state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend query methods are needed as all data is static and rendered directly in components.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom restaurant color palette (charcoal, gold, off-white) for light/dark themes, custom utility classes, and typography using Inter and Cormorant Garamond fonts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending default theme with custom restaurant colors (charcoal, gold, off-white), typography plugins, custom shadows, animations, and responsive container settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a single-page restaurant website for Perfetto Pizza Plus with comprehensive menu sections, business details, WhatsApp integration, and mobile-first responsive design features.
